about: Rose-Anne Landau attended law school and graduated from University at Buffalo Law School - SUNY in 1987. Rose-Anne Landau began practicing law in 1989.

Rose-Anne Landau is an attorney at Rose Anne Landau, P.C., helping people with Alternative Dispute Resolution issues. Rose Anne Landau, P.C. has an office in Denver, Colorado, serving the local community.

Rose-Anne Landau was selected to Super Lawyers for 2017 - 2027. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
